evidence.title: Crypto.com Visa Card — EEA product page (tier table, FAQ, disclaimers)
evidence.excerpt: Tier table: Midnight Blue free / 0% everyday; Ruby Steel €3.99/mo or €39.90/yr or €450 lock-up, 1.5% up to USD 750/mo; Jade/Indigo €24.99/mo or €249.90/yr or €4,500 lock-up, 2.5% up to USD 1,500; Icy/Rose Gold €45,000 lock-up 3.5% up to USD 3,000 then 0.5%; Obsidian €450,000 lock-up 4.5% up to USD 5,000 then 1%. Free ATM €200/€400/€800/€800/€1,000. Issuer Foris MT Limited. Prepaid card.
evidence.contradiction_note: Page says 'Visa' in title/footer but 'Prepaid Mastercard Card' in FAQ answers; meta claims zero FX fees while body says fees may apply. Record keeps Visa (issuer licence statement) and FX = unknown.

evidence.contradiction_note: The fee schedule's 'Monthly Spending Cap for Rewards' table states the caps as caps on SPEND ('rewards on the first USD 750 of monthly spending' for Plus/Ruby, etc.), while the EEA product page says 'earn up to USD 750/mo', which reads as a cap on REWARDS. The dated, dedicated fee schedule governs: the record models spend caps (decision 2026-10-31). The schedule's 2% outside-EU FX fee also contradicts the product page's 'zero foreign exchange fees' meta text.

editorial.summary: Prepaid Visa issued by Foris MT (Malta) for the EEA. The free tier earns no everyday rewards; paid tiers from €3.99/month earn 1.5–4.5% in CRO, but only on the first USD 750–5,000 of monthly spending, or require 12-month CRO lock-ups from €450 to €450,000.
good_for: People who accept a monthly fee or a 12-month CRO lock-up in exchange for CRO rewards on modest monthly spending
Streaming-subscription rebates on Ruby and above
not_for: Anyone who wants rewards without a fee or token lock (free tier earns 0% everyday)
High spenders: rewards stop after USD 750 (Ruby) or USD 1,500 (Jade/Indigo) of spending each month
Anyone who travels outside the EU/UK on the lower tiers (2% FX after the allowance)
watch_outs: Rewards and lock-ups are in CRO; their value moves with the token price. No appreciation is assumed anywhere on this site.
The reward cap is on spending, not on rewards: Ruby Steel at 1.5% earns at most about USD 11.25 of CRO per month against a €3.99 monthly fee.
Caps are stated in USD while pricing is in EUR.
Eligibility: no official country list has been read; confirm with the provider.
The product page contradicts itself on the card network (Visa vs Mastercard) and claims zero FX fees while the fee schedule charges 0.2%/2% on the lower tiers.
Inactivity fee of €6/month after 12 months without activity.
